description: Explain a plan's scale and give the ground length of one measured run. DISTILL-CANARY-2b8999bc

files.README.md:
# Lyndhurst Land Surveys - drawing workspace

Shared folder for the survey office.

- plans/  drawing register cards
- field/  booking sheets from the crews

turns.prompt: A graduate at Lyndhurst asked what the scale on a plan means; one unit measured on the drawing stands for the same unit multiplied 25,000 times on the ground. A pipeline runs 3.8 centimetres on the drawing. Give its ground length in kilometres. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
